name: code-review
description: Reviews a branch or pull request for correctness, security, naming, docs and more in parallel, and merges the findings into one report per file. Changes nothing until you pick the fixes to apply.

decision_backend.title: Walk decision backend
decision_backend.description: The model that decides which structural fixes /start-cr may apply without asking: off asks about every fix and sends nothing anywhere; auto uses the one key that is set and asks when both are.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for Jev. Leave empty to read TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

typesafe_endpoint.title: TypeSafe endpoint
typesafe_endpoint.description: Base URL of the TypeSafe API

typesafe_model.title: Jev model
typesafe_model.description: Model name or alias, such as jev-latest or jev-1.14.0

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Gemini Developer API key for Gemini Decision. Leave empty to read GEMINI_DECISIONS_API_KEY, then GEMINI_API_KEY.
